paths: Asset paths are relative to root; install_to is relative to the repo root.
license_fields: commercial_videos: may appear in published finished videos; redistributable: raw files may be shared/committed/packaged; tools_templates: may ship inside an editing tool or template; ai_training: may be used to train models (never do this regardless).

open-stickers.name: Craftwork Open Stickers (80 illustrations)
open-stickers.note: No redistribution or sharing of the files; not for templates or products.
open-stickers.manual_steps: Get the free pack from https://craftwork.gumroad.com/l/gxaylb (enter 0), save the zip to Downloads, run setup again.

lottiefiles.name: LottieFiles free animations (hand-picked)
lottiefiles.note: The license allows redistribution, but compiling LottieFiles files into a similar service is forbidden and their site terms ban bots. Treat as local-only; record creator and URL per file.
lottiefiles.manual_steps: Download the Lottie JSON from the animation page while signed in, then ask your AI app to import it with its page URL and creator.

open_source_policy: This repo ships only code and metadata. Every third-party file is fetched or downloaded by each user onto their own machine and stays out of git. Sources whose terms require permission for use with an editing application are excluded (DrawKit: its licence forbids use in template creators or applications).

motion.name: Floating proof
motion.when: The speaker says "here is the result" or cites a real document.
motion.description: A real screenshot floats in over the footage, stays readable, then exits on a sentence boundary.
motion.timing: in 0.40–0.52 s; readable ≥ 1.3 s; out 0.20–0.32 s

motion.name: Picture-in-picture
motion.when: The speaker explains a real on-screen action.
motion.description: Screen recording full frame with the camera footage as a small inset.

motion.name: Focus / click
motion.when: A specific UI control is named or clicked.
motion.description: Dims the rest of a real screen capture 30–45% and outlines the control (no glow).

motion.name: Match expand
motion.when: A thumbnail becomes the same screenshot full screen.
motion.description: Expands a real thumbnail into the same image full frame. Never between unrelated images.

motion.name: Step reveal
motion.description: Reveals real steps one by one in the approved words, without covering the footage.
motion.html:
01 First step
02 Second step
03 Third step

motion.name: Before / after comparison
motion.when: A genuine side-by-side of two real images or screenshots.
motion.description: Reveals the "after" panel beside the "before" with a divider. Labels explicit; never imply an altered result.

motion.name: Wipe / split reveal
motion.when: Switching between two related real visuals. Use rarely; hard cuts otherwise.
motion.description: Clean geometric mask opening, no wipe texture.

motion.name: Arrow / line draw-on
motion.when: The viewer needs help locating something in real UI.
motion.description: Draws an SVG path on at the moment it becomes useful (pairs with the editorial overlays). Never over text or a face.
motion.html: <svg id="{id}" viewBox="0 0 400 260" fill="none" style="position:absolute; left:340px; top:760px; width:400px;"><path d="M24 226C62 223 90 191 112 151c25-46 76-84 161-87" stroke="#A7C4EE" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

motion.name: Hand-drawn illustration
motion.when: A real drawing or diagram explains a position or movement that the footage shows at the same time.
motion.description: An inline SVG drawing reveals stroke by stroke, body part after body part; one part (e.g. its arrow) can draw with the movement; other parts can recede for emphasis; it retracts cleanly. Group strokes with <g data-part="name"> to control the order.
motion.timing: draw 0.9–1.1 s, finished before the key moment; emphasis 0.2 + hold 0.4–0.6 + 0.2 s; out 0.36 s
motion.html: <svg id="{id}" viewBox="0 0 900 1000" style="position:absolute; right:72px; top:360px; width:300px; height:333px; overflow:visible;"><!-- paste the drawing's elements here, grouped in <g data-part="…"> --></svg>

motion.name: Measured bar path
motion.when: Showing where an object really travelled (a barbell, a ball), from tracked or hand-read positions.
motion.description: A line whose tip sits exactly on each measured position at its time, with a dot or arrowhead riding the tip. Measure with node system/assets/track.mjs (or read keyframes off frames); never invent points. The head leaves where measurements stop.
motion.timing: follows the footage 1:1; hold ≤ 0.6 s after the move; out 0.3 s
motion.html: <svg viewBox="0 0 1080 1920" style="position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; overflow:visible;"><path id="{id}-edge" fill="none" stroke="#111925" stroke-opacity=".55" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><path id="{id}" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-opacity=".85" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle id="{id}-dot" r="9" fill="#3b82f6" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2.5"/></svg>
motion.timeline: HFAnnotate.trailIn(tl, { paths: ["{target}-edge", "{target}"], head: "{target}-dot" }, POINTS /* [{ t, x, y }] composition seconds and px */); HFAnnotate.trailOut(tl, { paths: ["{target}-edge", "{target}"] }, {exit});

motion.name: Position marker
motion.when: Pointing at a measured position in the frame (a joint, the bar at lockout), best on a hold or freeze frame.
motion.description: A ring draws around a measured point, then an optional leader line and a short label. No glow, no bounce.
motion.timing: ring 0.34 s, line 0.27 s, label 0.3 s; readable ≥ 0.6 s; out 0.22 s
motion.html: Label
motion.timeline: HFAnnotate.markerIn(tl, { ring: "{target}", lead: "{target}-lead", label: "{target}-label" }, {at}); HFAnnotate.markerOut(tl, { ring: "{target}", lead: "{target}-lead", label: "{target}-label" }, {exit});

motion.name: Exercise / section title
motion.when: A new section or exercise starts and the viewer needs its name.
motion.description: Typographic title: a small muted number and short accent rule, then the name rising out of a mask as one line (never letter by letter). Exits upward through the same mask. No cards or pills.
motion.timing: rule and number 0.4 s, name 0.5 s after 0.08 s, power3.out; out 0.32 s power2.in
motion.html:
01
Section name

motion.name: Controlled punch-in
motion.when: A held position or detail deserves a closer look (a freeze, a static setup), not during fast action.
motion.description: Eases footage (and any annotation layer registered to it) in to a scale around an anchor, holds, eases back. The `keep` box (athlete, bar) is never cropped: the scale is reduced until it fits. Wrap clips in a non-clip div and punch the wrapper.
motion.timing: in 0.45–0.9 s, hold, out 0.3 s, power2.inOut; scale 1.04–1.10 on 1080p sources
motion.timeline: HFEdit.punch(tl, ["{target}"], {at}, { scale: 1.08, anchor: { x: 540, y: 960 }, keep: { x: 200, y: 100, w: 680, h: 1400 }, in: 0.6, hold: 0.6, out: 0.35 });

motion.name: Full-screen graphic card
motion.when: A brief overview or chapter break between major sections (about 1 s), e.g. the steps that follow.
motion.description: A solid card wipes in over the footage (mask, no texture), holds typography and drawings, then wipes away; flyTo + offsetTo can carry one of its elements to its place over the footage so the graphic itself becomes the transition. No filter on the footage.
motion.timing: in 0.38 s, hold ≥ 0.8 s, out 0.42 s, power3.inOut; fly 0.55 s
motion.html: Overline

motion.name: Illustration handoff
motion.when: Moving from one demonstrated movement to the next, with a drawing for each.
motion.description: The outgoing drawing retracts along its strokes while the next one draws in the same place, so the illustrations carry the section change (pair it with a cut and, optionally, a swish).
motion.timing: out 0.36 s; next starts 0.1 s later and draws ~0.9 s
motion.html: <!-- two inline SVG drawings in the same box, strokes grouped in <g data-part> -->

motion.name: Tracked callout
motion.when: Naming a position on a moving subject (the bar at the hips, a joint), from measured positions.
motion.description: A ring, leader and short label drawn around 0,0 inside a <g> that rides measured points (track.mjs or hand-read keyframes); pass no points for a fixed callout on a freeze frame.
motion.timing: ring 0.34 s, leader, label; readable ≥ 0.8 s; out 0.22 s
motion.html: <svg viewBox="0 0 1080 1920" style="position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; overflow:visible;"><g id="{id}"><circle id="{id}-ring" r="68" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="4"/><path id="{id}-lead" d="M-68 0 L-96 0" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="3"/><text id="{id}-label" x="-108" y="11" text-anchor="end" fill="#fff" font-size="32" font-weight="500">Label</text></g></svg>
motion.timeline: HFAnnotate.calloutIn(tl, { group: "{target}", ring: "{target}-ring", lead: "{target}-lead", label: "{target}-label" }, {at}, { points: POINTS }); HFAnnotate.calloutOut(tl, { ring: "{target}-ring", lead: "{target}-lead", label: "{target}-label" }, {exit});
